mapper.select: SELECT w.gb_ai_workflow_id AS workflowId, w.gb_ai_workflow_code AS code, w.gb_ai_workflow_name AS name, w.gb_ai_workflow_description AS description, w.gb_ai_workflow_category AS category, aw.gb_ai_aw_sort_order AS bindSortOrder, aw.gb_ai_aw_pinned AS bindPinned, aw.gb_ai_aw_is_default AS bindIsDefault, aw.gb_ai_aw_relation_type AS relationType FROM gb_ai_workflow w INNER JOIN gb_ai_advisor_workflow aw ON aw.gb_ai_aw_workflow_id = w.gb_ai_workflow_id WHERE aw.gb_ai_aw_advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND w.gb_ai_workflow_enabled = 1 ORDER BY aw.gb_ai_aw_sort_order ASC, aw.gb_ai_aw_id ASC
